title: OpenAI to acquire Neptune
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI is acquiring Neptune to deepen visibility into model behavior and strengthen the tools researchers use to track experiments and monitor training....
body:
OpenAI is acquiring Neptune to deepen visibility into model behavior and strengthen the tools researchers use to track experiments and monitor training.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-neptune).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
